revisions.description: Move machine-global registered Store discovery out of the Explorer sidebar into the Project Selector, with deduplicated Store badges and a conditional dashboard relationship view.
revisions.reason: A permanent STORES sidebar section makes globally registered Stores look like children of every active project and obscures `store:` pointer versus `references:` relationships.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Make the Project Selector the always-visible Store configuration guidance surface, including validated version-pinned Store Guide and CLI links even when no Stores are registered.
revisions.reason: Users decide whether and how to configure Stores while viewing the Project Selector; hiding guidance until stores exist prevents the intended terminal-first discovery flow.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Replace the separate Registered Stores catalog and automatic Open Store flow with Store metadata enrichment on existing Project Selector project rows only.
revisions.reason: The Project Selector must remain the WebUI project registry. CLI Store discovery annotates matching registered project rows; a Store absent from that list is not directly openable in the WebUI.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Merge CLI-registered Stores and WebUI projects into one deduplicated, openable Project Selector list, and move native Store guidance to the selector header.
revisions.reason: Registered Stores are ordinary OpenSpec projects intentionally registered by the user, so they must be visible and selectable; the prior metadata-only model incorrectly hid Store-only roots and placed guidance away from the decision point.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Use living official OpenSpec Store documentation links in the Project Selector header instead of duplicating Store concepts and lifecycle instructions in WebUI copy.
revisions.reason: Stores are beta and their concepts, registration, and removal behavior may change; OpenSpec official documentation must remain the authoritative source.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Represent a pure Store root with a compact Dashboard header badge instead of a full Store Relationship card; reserve the card for actionable pointer or reference relationships.
revisions.reason: Store-root identity is passive metadata, while pointer and reference relationships provide navigation actions and need stronger visual prominence.
revisions.author: AI
